name: Unprefiltered Cubic B-Spline Reconstruction
definition: Reconstruction using the standard cubic B-spline filter without prefiltering. It is classified as a 2-EF (Error Function of order 2) reconstruction, meaning it is quasi-interpolating of order 2.
summary: Unprefiltered Cubic B-Spline Reconstruction is an approximating filter that smooths noisy voxel data without prefiltering, distinguishing itself by not passing through original sample values.
